coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 6 variable categories: consistent use of Docta, raw versus Docta-cleaned training data, and F1-based predictive performance measurement. The F1 match is at the metric level, not the specified task level.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed Anthropic Harmless and Red Team datasets with an unspecified dataset family, and BERT/GPT-2 with a frozen encoder and linear head. It evaluates primarily on ChatGPT–human disagreement cases using two alternative gold labels rather than the specified ChatGPT Cleaned and Human Sampled test subsets. It also substitutes generic multiclass classification for toxicity classification and does not anchor performance evaluation to Tables 6 and 7.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that Docta-cleaned training data should significantly improve F1 on both specified evaluation subsets, supporting improved label credibility through mitigation of raw-label inconsistencies.
